environment.isolation: Task source/adapters/vendor dependencies isolated under current workspace; existing generic WSL Python virtual environment reused read-only; no shared package installation

numerical_policy.input_dtype: float32 graph features/int64 tokens and edge indices
numerical_policy.determinism: Actual runtime deterministic_algorithms=true,warn_only=true; architecture-specific nondeterministic warnings retained; seeds0–9, no bit-exact CUDA claim
numerical_policy.notes: Snapshot inspected exact generic WSL interpreter and reused vendor modules; formal runner binds the same source and applies policy before model creation.

environment.lockfile_kind: Observed installed runtime snapshot, plus SHA-bound reused vendor dependency manifests in launch proof; no package install or lockfile synthesis

resources.start_gate: Actual root launch pool rechecks GPU process/usage, CPU affinity/RSS and immutable inputs before each new unit; WSL external-process visibility limitations preserved
resources.budget_basis: Same generic local WSL runtime/UUID, one scoring worker, CPU2/RSS4GiB/allocator3GiB; original global deadline retained

execution.seed_policy: Use this unchanged frozen selected seed; no resampling/refitting/selection

process_control.mechanism: Root-scoring private PGID, one worker, whole-tree RSS/deadline watchdog; actual launcher code frozen before issue

stop_conditions: 出现平台拒绝或缺少适用授权

training_regime.selection: lowest validation MAE by epoch and LR; ties lower candidate index
training_regime.holdout_scope: all retained test records, mutually exclusive chemistry strata plus608 annotation-discordance sensitivity flags; score only after selection frozen

input_encoding_audit.chemical_information_loss: Author graph inputs are stereochemistry-blind; full raw isomeric SMILES retained as provenance and evaluated for blind equivalence sensitivity.
input_encoding_audit.unrecognized_tokens_handling: Block with explicit failed coverage; no silent standard-AA substitution

evaluation_stage.global_matrix: 200selected units ×3datasets =600 independent score receipts; no gold/prediction/weight bytes read during administrative preparation
